bulk_publish_draft_notes.description: Publish all draft notes for a merge request. Optionally sets reviewer_state and posts a summary note (GitLab 19.2+). Can set reviewer_state even with no drafts. Use this for the specific operation described; choose a sibling tool when you need a different resource or lifecycle action. It changes remote GitLab state and requires the necessary project or group permission; GitLab returns validation, conflict, permission, or rate-limit errors instead of silently applying an invalid request. When `project_id` or `group_id` is accepted, provide the numeric ID or complete URL-encoded path described by the schema; use required identifiers and pagination fields exactly as documented.

internal.description: If true, the summary note is internal (GitLab 19.2+, default false)

merge_request_iid.description: The IID of a merge request

note.description: Summary note body to post on the merge request (GitLab 19.2+)

project_id.description: Project ID or complete URL-encoded path to project

reviewer_state.description: Set reviewer review state after publishing (GitLab 19.2+). Does not record a formal approval. Works even with no draft notes.
